static_traits.name: Zhang Min
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues；有几位朋友可交流，但尚not yet分享与工作相关的担忧
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet经历类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能配合探索，但持怀疑态度并伴随明显Self-denial

basic_info.main_problem: 在工作中感到not够胜任，并反复出现“我永远not会被晋升”的想法；这一切始于约六个月前一次因疏忽导致蔬菜报损的失误。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling now because these thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and job satisfaction.
growth_experiences: 约六个月前，来访者在杂货店工作时因疏忽让一批蔬菜报损。虽然雇主并not yet当场责备或明确表达负面评价，但该事件在她心中挥之not去。自此，她持续反复回想这次失误，并相信它严重阻碍了自己的晋升机会；每当出现晋升机会的消息或讨论，她都会自动联想到这次失误并认为“他们not会考虑我”。在此影响下，她开始加倍工作、格外勤勉以“弥补”错误，同时与同事的关系因她的Anxiety和Self-doubt而趋于紧张，逐渐减少与同事交流。她也not yet将这些担忧与朋友分享，生活中对原本喜欢的活动失去兴趣，自尊与工作满意度明显下降。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough（not够好）

special_situations.event: 六个月前在工作中因疏忽导致一批蔬菜报损
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one obvious mistake, I will permanently destroy my promotion opportunity
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班加点、更加勤勉来“弥补”错误

special_situations.event: 公司出现晋升机会的公告或讨论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not是完美without错，就not可能被晋升
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: When promotion approaches, pressures oneself and overworks to seek 'perfect performance'

special_situations.event: 雇主当时not yet对失误进行明确责备或说明
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not明确的赞许或说明，就代表他们对我失去信任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少与管理层的沟通以避免被注意或评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们已经对我失去信心了

special_situations.event: 与同事的日常互动与协作
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同事觉得我有问题，说明我确实not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与同事交谈，Reduced socializing接触
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们可能认为我有问题

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and promoted, to gain others' trust and affirmation
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被视为without能，担心一次错误导致持续的羞耻与Being rejected
defense_goal: Through excessive diligence and self-criticism, maintains a sense of value and avoids negative external evaluations
保持疏离与减少沟通以降低被批评或再次暴露not足的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够胜任、容易犯错并需要not断补偿的员工
object_relations.object_representation: 冷静但潜在严苛、随时可能negate自己的评判者（上级/同事）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment to test his belief about promotion
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将“损害已not可逆”视为合理前提，认为咨询难以改变现实（类似对改变的悲观预设）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以礼貌但怀疑的语气表达担忧（如“我not确定这能改变什么”），语速平稳、保持基本合作，但强调自身顾虑。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor probes for concrete evidence about 'others losing trust' and conducts a fact check
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的Self-denial与not被认可的担忧归因于他人，相信他人已对自己失望（移情：将内在not安投向他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 坚持对他人负面看法的主观判断，use含糊的措辞（如“他们一定记着我的错误”），回避细节证据，同时保持基本交流。

manifestations: Living alone且not yet向朋友分享工作相关担忧
减少与同事的交流，关系趋于紧张
对以往喜欢的活动失去兴趣

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自责“I am not good enough”
在晋升机会出现时过度自我审视与施压
担心他人的评价而缩减交流

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing my superior has lost trust in me, despite lacking clear evidence
Feeling colleagues 'may think I have a problem' and reducing contact because of it

positive_force: 愿意尝试行为实验，具备一定的合作意愿
在工作中持续努力、勤勉以提升表现
具备一定社会支持（有几位朋友可交流）
negative_force: 过度概括与预测not yet来等认知偏差ReinforcementSelf-denial
Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation（如晋升）
与同事互动回避导致支持减少与Relationship tension
Impaired self-esteem、兴趣下降影响职业投入

公司发布或讨论晋升机会时
感到他人可能在评价自己

target_behavior.core_reason: 以“必须完美without错才能被认可”的条件假设来Undoing“I am not competent enough”的核心信念，从而通过过度努力寻求安全感与价值感
target_behavior.function: 试图Gaining recognition并降低被negate的风险
